title: One front door, and the hub runs nothing
design_ref: Sending work to the right cluster; The architecture at a glance
purpose: Submit a job once to the hub. It must run in a worker, report its status back to the hub, leave no pod on the hub, and be refused if someone tries to run a pod on the hub directly.

steps.display: kubectl --context hub -n llm run rogue --image=python:3.12-slim   # a pod that passes every security check, run on the hub directly
steps.output: The pods "rogue" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'hub-runs-no-user-pods' with binding 'hub-runs-no-user-pods' denied request: The hub cluster runs no user workloads. Submit a Job to your LocalQueue; MultiKueue runs it in a worker cluster.

steps.display: kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # llm/front-door: queue cpu, 2 pod(s) x cpu 1
kubectl --context hub -n llm get workload,job   # the hub's single view of the job
steps.output:
NAME                                           QUEUE   RESERVED IN   ADMITTED   FINISHED   AGE
workload.kueue.x-k8s.io/job-front-door-649bf   cpu     llm-cpu       True                  2s

NAME                   STATUS    COMPLETIONS   DURATION   AGE
job.batch/front-door   Running   0/2           2s         3s

steps.display: kubectl --context hub -n llm get pods   # nothing runs on the hub
steps.output: No resources found in llm namespace.

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a -n llm get pods -o wide   # the pods are here
steps.output:
NAME               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP       NODE     NOMINATED NODE   READINESS GATES
front-door-9lq7l   0/1     Pending   0          7s    <none>   <none>   <none>           <none>
front-door-p9snc   0/1     Pending   0          7s    <none>   <none>   <none>           <none>

steps.display: kubectl --context hub -n llm get job front-door   # status mirrored back
steps.output:
NAME         STATUS     COMPLETIONS   DURATION   AGE
front-door   Complete   2/2           73s        79s

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a -n llm get jobs   # the remote copy is cleaned up
steps.output: No resources found in llm namespace.

checks.description: a pod created directly on the hub is refused
checks.because: A ValidatingAdmissionPolicy on the hub denies every pod in a team namespace.

checks.description: the hub chose a worker for the job
checks.because: The job's Workload on the hub records where it was sent: cpu-a.

checks.description: no pod exists on the hub
checks.because: The hub keeps a suspended copy of the job. Pods exist only in the worker that admitted it.

checks.description: the job's pods are running in that worker
checks.because: MultiKueue created the Job in the winning worker, linked to the Workload that worker admitted.

checks.description: the job completed and its status is visible on the hub
checks.because: The hub watches the remote job and copies its status. The user never needs worker credentials.

checks.description: the remote copy was deleted when the job finished
checks.because: After the final status sync the hub deletes the remote objects.
